title: Reply with Template option missing
creator: rousea
content:
I want to configure an automatic response to emails that have been forwarded to me from a particular address. I have created a template for the response and it is saved in the Templates folder. I then attempted to create a Filter Rule to send the response. I believe there should be a Reply with Template option in the Perform these action pull-down, but there isn't. I've attached a screen shot to illustrate this.

I'm using Thunderbird 154.0 and Windows 11. Is there a new way of achieving my objective?

title: 迷惑マーク（S）とスターマーク（S)が同じショートカットキー
creator: yukiire.red
content:
After first pressing "Mark" (K), the shortcut keys for "Mark as Junk" (S) and "Star" (S) are the same. Previously, the shortcut key for "Mark as Junk" was (J). Please make the necessary corrections.

最初に「マークを付ける」（K)を押してから、「迷惑マークを付ける」（S）と「スターを付ける」（S)のショートカットキーが同じです。 以前は迷惑マークのショートカットキーは（J)でした。

修正願います。

title: Changed my shaw email password and now thunderbird won't download messages

content: I had to recently change my password on my shaw email account. Now thunderbird won't download my emails. Any idea what I'm doing wrong by simply changing the password? I think this happened before and some wonderful human on this forum told me I had to put something before the password or click/unclick a particular box, but I can't find that old answer to my previous question. Thanks in advance for any help someone can offer!
